lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\EmlViewer\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
vendor/ ships 2 packages that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 35. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.
laravel/serializable-closure v2.1.0, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 35
psr/container 2.0.2, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 35

boot() registers a listener or takes a service from the container in 1 place. boot() runs once for every process of the server, so each of them is built on every request. registerEventListener() in register() builds a listener only when its event fires.
